items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He did well and worked with Paul Winter

ctx.x: Well, it was a name in East Indian folklore of two mythical legend islands in India somewhere. There’s a little more to it then I can remember but their names (were) Ruta and Daitya. So, after that somehow I met Manfred and was asked to do recording because Manfred was interested in recording artists who had played with Miles, and he knew my work with CTI and other things. So, I had my group and we had a tour, and think we recorded after the tour. I wrote the music for the recording, which had Alex [Foster]……
Which you played tenor saxophone on.
